skill.title: Apply Corollary 6: Circles sharing a tangent at a point: the centres and that point are collinear
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Corollary 6

candidates.question:
Two circles touch externally at the point $T$.
The centres are $A$ and $B$, and the radii are $6$ cm and $9$ cm.
Find $|AB|$.

lines.text: The two centres and the point of contact $T$ are collinear, with $T$ between $A$ and $B$ (Corollary 6).

candidates.question:
A circle with centre $A$ and radius $12$ cm contains a smaller circle with centre $B$ and radius $5$ cm.
The circles touch internally at the point $T$.
Find $|AB|$.

lines.text: The centres $A$, $B$ and the point of contact $T$ are collinear, with $B$ between $A$ and $T$ (Corollary 6).

candidates.question:
The circle $c_1$ has centre $O(0,0)$ and passes through $T(3,4)$.
The circle $c_2$ has radius $10$ and touches $c_1$ externally at $T$.
Find the coordinates of the centre of $c_2$.

lines.text: so the radius of $c_1$ is $5$.
The centre $C$ of $c_2$ lies on the line $OT$, beyond $T$ (Corollary 6).
$|OC| = 15 = 3 \times |OT|$, so $C$ is $3$ times as far from $O$ as $T$ is, in the same direction.

skill.title: Apply Theorem 1: Vertically opposite angles are equal
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Theorem 1

candidates.question:
The straight lines $AD$ and $BE$ intersect at the point $C$, with $C$ between $A$ and $D$ and between $B$ and $E$.
In the triangle $ABC$, $|\angle BAC| = 50^\circ$ and $|\angle ABC| = 60^\circ$.
Find $|\angle DCE|$.

lines.text: The angles in a triangle add to $180^\circ$.
$\angle ACB$ and $\angle DCE$ are vertically opposite, so they are equal.

candidates.question:
The straight lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at the point $O$.
$|\angle AOC| = (3x + 10)^\circ$ and $|\angle BOD| = (5x - 30)^\circ$.
Find $|\angle AOD|$.

lines.text: $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$ are vertically opposite, so they are equal.
$\angle AOC$ and $\angle AOD$ lie on the straight line $CD$, so they add to $180^\circ$.

candidates.question:
The straight lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at the point $O$.
$|\angle AOC| = (2x + y)^\circ$, $|\angle BOD| = 70^\circ$ and $|\angle AOD| = (x + 3y)^\circ$.
Find the value of $x$ and the value of $y$.

lines.text: $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$ are vertically opposite, so they are equal.
$\angle AOC$ and $\angle AOD$ lie on a straight line, so they add to $180^\circ$.

skill.title: Apply Theorem 10: Diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Theorem 10

candidates.question:
$ABCD$ is a parallelogram. Its diagonals $[AC]$ and $[BD]$ intersect at $E$.
$|AC| = 18$ cm and $|BD| = 11$ cm.
Find $|BE|$.

lines.text: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so $E$ is the midpoint of $[BD]$.

candidates.question:
$PQRS$ is a parallelogram. Its diagonals meet at $M$.
$|PM| = 3x + 1$ and $|MR| = 5x - 5$.
Find the value of $x$.

lines.text: The diagonals bisect each other, so $M$ is the midpoint of $[PR]$ and $|PM| = |MR|$.

candidates.question:
$ABCD$ is a parallelogram. Its diagonals meet at $E$.
$|AE| = 2x + 3$ and $|AC| = 5x - 1$.
Find the value of $x$.

lines.text: The diagonals bisect each other, so $E$ is the midpoint of $[AC]$ and $|AC| = 2|AE|$.

skill.title: Apply Theorem 11: Three parallel lines cutting equal segments on one transversal cut equal segments on any
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Theorem 11

candidates.question:
Three parallel lines cut two transversals, one at $A$, $B$, $C$ and the other at $D$, $E$, $F$.
$|AB| = |BC|$ and $|DE| = 4.5$ cm.
Find $|DF|$.

lines.text: Three parallel lines cutting equal segments on one transversal cut equal segments on any transversal. $|AB| = |BC|$, so $|DE| = |EF|$.

skill.title: Apply Theorem 12: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two in the same ratio
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Theorem 12

candidates.question:
In triangle $ABC$, $D$ is on $[AB]$ and $E$ is on $[AC]$ with $DE \parallel BC$.
$|AD| = 6$ cm, $|DB| = 4$ cm and $|AE| = 9$ cm.
Find $|EC|$.

lines.text: $DE \parallel BC$, so $DE$ divides $[AB]$ and $[AC]$ in the same ratio (Theorem 12).

candidates.question:
In triangle $ABC$, $|AC| = 15$ cm.
The point $D$ is on $[AB]$ and $E$ is on $[AC]$ with $DE \parallel BC$.
$|AD| : |DB| = 4 : 6$.
Find $|AE|$.

lines.text: $DE \parallel BC$, so $|AE| : |EC| = |AD| : |DB| = 4 : 6$ (Theorem 12).
Let $|AE| = x$, so $|EC| = 15 - x$.

steps.title: Find $|XY|$ by Pythagoras in the right-angled triangle $AXY$

lines.text: $XY \parallel BC$ and $XZ \parallel AC$, so $XYCZ$ is a parallelogram and opposite sides are equal.

steps.title: Use the parallel lines to find $|BZ|$

lines.text: $XZ \parallel AC$ cuts $[BA]$ and $[BC]$ in the same ratio, so $|BZ| : |ZC| = |BX| : |XA|$.
Since $|AX| : |XB| = 1 : 2$ and $|AX| = 4$, we get $|XB| = 8$.
